note: schema_type! / schema! pick and omit names resolve one way: a Rust identifier first, then the serde JSON name, with cfg-inactive fields ignored; a JSON name shared by two fields and a serde-skipped field are refused with a spanned error. A cfg-removed twin no longer makes a JSON name ambiguous. Plus: inline-module platform twins resolve to nothing, a garde adapt(path) is re-rooted, a generic parameter path is kept, library src/bin files are modules, and the schema fingerprint map is keyed per item.
